title: Plastic Man #13 DC Comics February 2005 Kyle Baker Story Art Cover
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Plastic Man #13 (February 2005), DC Comics. Written and drawn by Kyle Baker, with a Kyle Baker cover - from his Eisner Award-winning Plastic Man run.

Back cover: Wrigley's Hubba Bubba Max gum ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
